points.name: Tsubame Onsen Ogon-no-yu
points.season: About April to November. Closed in winter.
points.access: Short walk from the top of Tsubame Onsen village.
points.note: Free, sunrise to sunset, separate men's and women's pools. Closed Mondays and Friday mornings for cleaning. Bring gumboots during the snowmelt.
